hero.title: Learn without limits with our platform
hero.subtitle: Discover premium learning tracks that help you develop your skills and reach your career goals.

features.title: Everything you need to excel in one place
features.subtitle: We designed the platform based on students' needs, to provide you with a fun, distraction-free learning experience that supports you step by step.

offline.title: Watch Offline
offline.description: Download lectures and notes (PDFs) within the app to study anytime, anywhere without consuming your data plan.

directContact.title: Direct Communication
directContact.description: Have a question? Ask the doctor or lecturer directly through the internal Chat system available in every course.

ranking.title: Ranking System
ranking.description: Solve exams, collect points, and compete with your peers for the top positions on the honor board to encourage you to continue.

security.title: Safe and Exclusive Environment
security.description: Your account is dedicated to your personal device only, ensuring a stable learning experience and protecting content rights.

howItWorks.title: Your journey with us is easier than you imagine
howItWorks.subtitle: Just 3 steps separate you from starting a different learning experience.

step1.title: Register your account
step1.description: Create your new account and link it to your favorite device to ensure privacy and speed of entry in the future.

step2.title: Choose and subscribe
step2.description: Browse available courses, pay electronically easily and securely, and the course will be activated in your account immediately.

step3.title: Start learning and competing
step3.description: Watch lectures, solve exams, track your progress bar, and compete for the top of the rankings!

courses.title: Educational Tracks and Bundles
courses.subtitle: Subscribe to the appropriate track for you, and open all materials and chapters belonging to it with one click.

cta.title: Ready to lead the honor board?
cta.subtitle: Learning is not just videos; interact with content, solve quizzes, and collect points so your name appears in first place for your peers!

contact.title: Have a question? We are here to help!
contact.subtitle: Whether you are a student needing help, or a parent wanting to follow up, the technical support team is always available to answer all your questions.
